notes: High-sensitivity PHI environment - must support per-document audit trail and immutable access logs.
Primary ask: hybrid RAG pipeline with embeddings-based candidate retrieval + cross-encoder reranking (clinical accuracy prioritized over raw throughput).
Indexing scale: initial target 50M docs for POC, long-term 100M+; expect frequent small updates (daily incremental ingestion).
Latency SLO: retrieval+rerank p50 <= 200ms, p95 < 800ms for typical queries. Customer is willing to accept occasional batch rerank for long-tail queries.
Cost sensitivity: wants to quantify cost per query for 1k, 10k, 100k QPS volumes; main levers requested: batching windows, quantization profile, rerank concurrency limits.
Security notes: must deploy in customer VPC or on-prem, use customer KMS/HSM, retention controls to purge PHI on request, field-level redaction for certain document classes.
Quote from Director of Clinical Informatics: "We need deterministic audit for any clinician query that surfaces patient data — timestamp, user, query text, returned doc IDs."

SE recommendation: use two-stage retrieval — 1) dense ANN (quantized 768-d embeddings) + metadata filters, 2) small cross-encoder (FP16) for top-100 rerank. Consider cold-cache batch reranking overnight for analytics queries.
Requested deliverables before POC: architecture diagram for on-prem bundle, perf benchmarks with 50M index, cost model with breakouts (storage, embedding compute, rerank GPU hours).
Open legal: BAA + indemnity on data breach. Ops ask: support for SIEM forwarding (Splunk) and long-term immutable audit export (90+ days).
Drive artifacts: shared pricing deck and security FAQ. Fireflies notes link contains verbatim ask about per-record redaction and S3 encryption-at-rest + in-transit details.
Short-term win: run a small index (5M docs) on hosted private cluster to demo retrieval quality and audit logging; this will accelerate legal signoff.
